title: Checkpoint: bank the easy parts first
prompt: The full three-behavior class `ReadingSet` (constructor stores the array): `countCold()` counts readings < 0.0; `anyWarm()` is true when any reading > 25.0; `firstCold()` returns the first reading < 0.0 or 999.0. **Strategy exercise**: implement them in banking order — count, exists, first-match — as if the clock were running.

tests.name: banked in order
tests.hint: Each behavior is one known pattern; the exercise is doing them in point-maximizing order without gold-plating.
